headline: Cencora (COR) Stock Looks Undervalued As Its 167% Five Year Return Builds
summary: Cencora stock has delivered a strong 167.1% return over the past 5 years, yet its current valuation still screens as cheap. An intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model suggests the shares trade at a meaningful discount to that estimate, while market multiples also lean toward an undervalued verdict. A 167.1% total return over 5 years sets a high bar for Cencora. Any hint that cash flow growth slows or that returns on capital plateau may make the current valuation...
